candidate.title: embedurl param not type-checked allows non-String, causing unrescued TypeError in URI parsing and Sidekiq retry churn
reports: embedcontroller.rb:9-16 / topicretriever.rb:15-18: embedurl is never validated as a string — params.require(:embedurl) happily returns an array/hash (?embedurl[]=x), and uri(@embedurl) in invalidhost? raises typeerror (not uri::invalidurierror) which escapes the rescue, so each such request enqueues a job that crashes on its first statement and burns through sidekiq retries — anonymous-triggerable job churn. validate it's a string before enqueueing.
